entities.name: A0QRN3 urocanate hydratase
observations: The submitted 552-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt A0QRN3 from Mycolicibacterium smegmatis.
Catalyzes urocanate hydration to 4-imidazolone-5-propionate (EC 4.2.1.49); annotated to bind one NAD(+) per subunit.
Annotated cytoplasmic; participates in L-histidine degradation toward L-glutamate.
